7 انغمس (S, A, Msb) and ↓ اغتمس (S, A) He, or it, became immersed, immerged, dipped, plunged, or sunk, in water: or he immersed or immerged himself, plunged, or dived, in water: (S, A, Msb:) or he did so remaining long therein. (TA in this art. and in art. رمس.) [See ارتمس.] ―
-b2- [Hence,] ↓ the latter also signifies, [and so app. the former,] (assumed tropical:) He hid, or concealed, himself. (T, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
